Script.name: ZeroPoint Unified Client
Script.script:
ZeroPoint = ZeroPoint or {} local ZP = ZeroPoint ZP.version = "1.5.0" ZP.enabled = ZP.enabled ~= false ZP.visible = ZP.visible ~= false ZP.adminVisible = ZP.adminVisible ~= false ZP.currentRoom = ZP.currentRoom ZP.lastRoom = ZP.lastRoom ZP.lastPacket = ZP.lastPacket ZP.roomExits = ZP.roomExits or {} ZP.aliasIDs = ZP.aliasIDs or {} ZP.eventIDs = ZP.eventIDs or {} ZP.built = ZP.built or false ZP.msdpSeen = ZP.msdpSeen or false ZP.isImmortal = ZP.isImmortal == true ZP.buildLevel = tonumber(ZP.buildLevel) or 0 ZP.envForColor = ZP.envForColor or {} ZP.roomBaseEnv = ZP.roomBaseEnv or {} ZP.roomAppliedColor = ZP.roomAppliedColor or {} ZP.mapRatio = tonumber(ZP.mapRatio) or 0.28 ZP.uiRevision = "1.5.0" local MSDP_DIRS = { n="north", north="north", ne="northeast", northeast="northeast", e="east", east="east", se="southeast", southeast="southeast", s="south", south="south", sw="southwest", southwest="southwest", w="west", west="west", nw="northwest", northwest="northwest", u="up", up="up", d="down", down="down", ["in"]="in", inside="in", out="out", outside="out" } local STANDARD_DIRS = { "north","northeast","east","southeast","south","southwest", "west","northwest","up","down","in","out" } local DELTA = { north={0,1,0}, northeast={1,1,0}, east={1,0,0}, southeast={1,-1,0}, south={0,-1,0}, southwest={-1,-1,0}, west={-1,0,0}, northwest={-1,1,0}, up={0,0,1}, down={0,0,-1}, ["in"]={0,0,1}, out={0,0,-1} } local ROOM_COLOR_ENV = { ["#00AFC8"]=51001, ["#D8AD3D"]=51002, ["#A65353"]=51003, ["#D97706"]=51004, ["#35A86B"]=51005, ["#A95C32"]=51006, ["#B47B26"]=51007, ["#C06BAE"]=51008, ["#9B7CC1"]=51009, ["#7AAE7A"]=51010, ["#6F8FC4"]=51011, ["#B85C5C"]=51012 } local function trim(s) return tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end local function stripMudColors(s) local text = tostring(s or "") text = text:gsub("&#[%x][%x][%x][%x][%x][%x]", "") text = text:gsub("&.", "") return trim(text) end local function patternEscape(s) return tostring(s or ""):gsub("([%%%^%$%(%)%.%[%]%*%+%-%?])", "%%%1") end local function tagLabels(raw) local labels = {} if type(raw) ~= "table" then return labels end for key, value in pairs(raw) do local label if tonumber(key) then label = trim(value) else label = trim(key) end if label ~= "" then table.insert(labels, label) end end table.sort(labels) return labels end local function baseRoomName(data) local text = stripMudColors(type(data) == "table" and (data.NAME or data.name) or data) if type(data) == "table" then for _, label in ipairs(tagLabels(data.TAGS or data.tags)) do text = text:gsub("%s*%[" .. patternEscape(label) .. "%]", "") end end return trim(text) end local function displayRoomName(data) local text = baseRoomName(data) for _, label in ipairs(tagLabels(type(data) == "table" and (data.TAGS or data.tags) or nil)) do text = text .. " [" .. label .. "]" end return trim(text) end local function echo(msg) cecho("\n[ZeroPoint] " .. msg .. "\n") end local function roomExists(id) id = tonumber(id) if not id or id <= 0 then return false end local ok, name = pcall(getRoomName, id) return ok and name ~= nil end local function ensureArea(name) name = trim(name) if name == "" then name = "Zero Point" end local areas = getAreaTable() or {} if areas[name] then return areas[name] end return addAreaName(name) end local function roomsAt(areaID, x, y, z) if type(getRoomsByPosition1) == "function" then local ok, rooms = pcall(getRoomsByPosition1, areaID, x, y, z) if ok and type(rooms) == "table" then return rooms end end if type(getRoomsByPosition) == "function" then local ok, rooms = pcall(getRoomsByPosition, areaID, x, y, z) if ok and type(rooms) == "table" then local result = {} for _, roomID in pairs(rooms) do table.insert(result, roomID) end return result end end local result = {} if type(getAreaRooms) == "function" then local ok, rooms = pcall(getAreaRooms, areaID) if ok and type(rooms) == "table" then for _, roomID in pairs(rooms) do local rx, ry, rz = getRoomCoordinates(roomID) if tonumber(rx) == x and tonumber(ry) == y and tonumber(rz) == z then table.insert(result, roomID) end end end end return result end local function coordinateOccupied(areaID, x, y, z, ignoreRoom) for _, roomID in pairs(roomsAt(areaID, x, y, z)) do if tonumber(roomID) ~= tonumber(ignoreRoom) then return true end end return false end local function collisionFreeCoordinates(areaID, x, y, z, roomID, dir) if not coordinateOccupied(areaID, x, y, z, roomID) then return x, y, z, false end local candidates = {} local d = DELTA[dir] or {0,0,0} if d[1] ~= 0 or d[2] ~= 0 then table.insert(candidates, {x - d[2], y + d[1]}) table.insert(candidates, {x + d[2], y - d[1]}) end for radius = 1, 12 do for dx = -radius, radius do table.insert(candidates, {x + dx, y + radius}) table.insert(candidates, {x + dx, y - radius}) end for dy = -radius + 1, radius - 1 do table.insert(candidates, {x + radius, y + dy}) table.insert(candidates, {x - radius, y + dy}) end end local seen = {} for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do local cx, cy = candidate[1], candidate[2] local key = tostring(cx) .. ":" .. tostring(cy) if not seen[key] then seen[key] = true if not coordinateOccupied(areaID, cx, cy, z, roomID) then return cx, cy, z, true end end end local nz = z + 1 while coordinateOccupied(areaID, x, y, nz, roomID) do nz = nz + 1 end return x, y, nz, true end local function findArrivalDirection(fromRoom, toRoom) if not fromRoom or not toRoom then return nil end local exits = ZP.roomExits[tonumber(fromRoom)] if type(exits) ~= "table" then return nil end local found for dir, dest in pairs(exits) do if tonumber(dest) == tonumber(toRoom) then if found then return nil end found = dir end end return found end local function nextCoordinates(fromRoom, dir) if not fromRoom or not dir or not roomExists(fromRoom) then return 0,0,0 end local x,y,z = getRoomCoordinates(fromRoom) x,y,z = tonumber(x) or 0, tonumber(y) or 0, tonumber(z) or 0 local d = DELTA[dir] if not d then return x,y,z end return x+d[1], y+d[2], z+d[3] end local function serverCoordinates(data) if type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end local isSet = tonumber(data.COORDS_SET or data.coords_set or data.ROOM_COORDS_SET) if isSet ~= 1 then return nil end local x = tonumber(data.X or data.x or data.ROOM_X) local y = tonumber(data.Y or data.y or data.ROOM_Y) local z = tonumber(data.Z or data.z or data.ROOM_Z) if not x or not y or not z then return nil end return {x=x, y=y, z=z} end local function hexToRgb(color) local hex = trim(color):gsub("^#", "") if not hex:match("^[%x][%x][%x][%x][%x][%x]$") then return nil end return tonumber(hex:sub(1,2),16), tonumber(hex:sub(3,4),16), tonumber(hex:sub(5,6),16) end local function applyRoomColor(roomID, color) roomID = tonumber(roomID) color = trim(color):upper() if not roomID or roomID <= 0 then return end if ZP.roomBaseEnv[roomID] == nil and type(getRoomEnv) == "function" then local ok, env = pcall(getRoomEnv, roomID) if ok then ZP.roomBaseEnv[roomID] = env end end if color == "" then if ZP.roomAppliedColor[roomID] and ZP.roomBaseEnv[roomID] ~= nil and type(setRoomEnv) == "function" then pcall(setRoomEnv, roomID, ZP.roomBaseEnv[roomID]) end ZP.roomAppliedColor[roomID] = nil return end local r,g,b = hexToRgb(color) if not r then return end local envID = ZP.envForColor[color] or ROOM_COLOR_ENV[color] if not envID then -- Unknown future colours still receive a deterministic environment ID so -- map persistence cannot remap existing rooms merely because visit order -- changed between client sessions. envID = 52000 + ((r * 31 + g * 17 + b) % 7000) end ZP.envForColor[color] = envID if type(setCustomEnvColor) == "function" then pcall(setCustomEnvColor, envID, r, g, b, 255) end if type(setRoomEnv) == "function" then pcall(setRoomEnv, roomID, envID) ZP.roomAppliedColor[roomID] = color end end local function ensureRoom(id, name, areaName, fromRoom, dir, coords, color) id = tonumber(id) if not id or id <= 0 then return nil end local areaID = ensureArea(areaName) local isNew = not roomExists(id) if isNew then addRoom(id, areaID) else pcall(setRoomArea, id, areaID) end if coords then pcall(setRoomCoordinates, id, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z) if type(setRoomUserData) == "function" then pcall(setRoomUserData, id, "zeropoint_coordinates", "server") pcall(setRoomUserData, id, "zeropoint_layout_collision", "0") end elseif isNew then local x,y,z = nextCoordinates(fromRoom, dir) local px,py,pz,shifted = collisionFreeCoordinates(areaID, x, y, z, id, dir) setRoomCoordinates(id, px, py, pz) if shifted and type(setRoomUserData) == "function" then pcall(setRoomUserData, id, "zeropoint_layout_collision", "1") end end if name and trim(name) ~= "" then setRoomName(id, trim(name)) end applyRoomColor(id, color) return id end local function normaliseExits(raw) if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil end local result = {} for rawDir, rawDest in pairs(raw) do local dir = MSDP_DIRS[trim(rawDir):lower()] local dest = tonumber(rawDest) if dir and dest and dest > 0 then result[dir] = dest end end return result end local function reconcileRoom(roomID, exits, areaName) if type(exits) ~= "table" then return end local localExits = getRoomExits(roomID) or {} for _, dir in ipairs(STANDARD_DIRS) do local existing = tonumber(localExits[dir]) local wanted = tonumber(exits[dir]) if existing and existing > 0 and existing ~= wanted then setExit(roomID, -1, dir) end end for _, dir in ipairs(STANDARD_DIRS) do local destID = tonumber(exits[dir]) if destID and destID > 0 then local destination = ensureRoom(destID, nil, areaName, roomID, dir) if destination then local current = tonumber((getRoomExits(roomID) or {})[dir]) if current ~= destination then if current and current > 0 then setExit(roomID, -1, dir) end setExit(roomID, destination, dir) end end end end updateMap() end local function orderedValues(raw) local values = {} if type(raw) ~= "table" then return values end local numbered, other = {}, {} for key, value in pairs(raw) do local n = tonumber(key) if n then table.insert(numbered, {number=n, value=tostring(value or "")}) else table.insert(other, {key=tostring(key), value=tostring(value or "")}) end end table.sort(numbered, function(a,b) return a.number < b.number end) table.sort(other, function(a,b) return a.key < b.key end) for _,v in ipairs(numbered) do table.insert(values, v.value) end for _,v in ipairs(other) do table.insert(values, v.value) end return values end local function section(console, title, raw) local values = orderedValues(raw) console:cecho("" .. title .. " (" .. tostring(#values) .. ")\n") if #values == 0 then console:cecho(" None\n\n") else for _, value in ipairs(values) do console:echo(" • " .. value .. "\n") end console:echo("\n") end end local META_STYLE = [[ QLabel { background-color: rgb(23, 28, 33); color: rgb(166, 181, 193); padding-left: 10px; padding-right: 10px; font-size: 10px; border-top: 2px solid rgb(61, 190, 230); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(44, 54, 62); } ]] local BUILDER_TITLE_STYLE = [[ QLabel { background-color: rgb(20, 27, 32); color: rgb(107, 220, 255); padding-left: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(48, 61, 70); } ]] local BUILDER_BUTTON_STYLE = [[ QLabel { background-color: rgb(31, 43, 51); color: rgb(224, 232, 237); border: 1px solid rgb(59, 76, 87); font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; } QLabel::hover { background-color: rgb(39, 61, 72); color: rgb(116, 224, 255); } ]] local BUILDER_INPUT_STYLE = [[ QPlainTextEdit { background-color: rgb(9, 14, 18); color: rgb(235, 245, 250); border: 1px solid rgb(82, 105, 119); border-radius: 2px; padding: 4px; selection-background-color: rgb(38, 111, 137); selection-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 10px; } QPlainTextEdit:focus { border: 1px solid rgb(73, 202, 240); background-color: rgb(12, 20, 25); } ]] local BUILDER_FIELD_STYLE = [[ QLabel { background-color: rgb(15, 21, 26); color: rgb(139, 205, 224); padding-left: 7px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; } ]] local VIEW_BUTTON_STYLE = [[ QLabel { background-color: rgb(24, 31, 37); color: rgb(153, 169, 181); border-top: 1px solid rgb(58, 71, 81); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(58, 71, 81); border-right: 1px solid rgb(46, 57, 66); font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; } QLabel::hover { background-color: rgb(34, 47, 56); color: rgb(103, 221, 255); } ]] local VIEW_BUTTON_ACTIVE_STYLE = [[ QLabel { background-color: rgb(31, 58, 69); color: rgb(119, 225, 255); border-top: 1px solid rgb(71, 196, 232); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(71, 196, 232); border-right: 1px solid rgb(46, 57, 66); font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; } ]] local DIRECTION_LABELS = { north="NORTH", northeast="NORTHEAST", east="EAST", southeast="SOUTHEAST", south="SOUTH", southwest="SOUTHWEST", west="WEST", northwest="NORTHWEST", up="UP", down="DOWN", ["in"]="IN", out="OUT" } local function activeLayoutName(ratio) ratio = tonumber(ratio) or 0.28 if ratio <= 0.24 then return "room" end if ratio >= 0.39 then return "map" end return "balanced" end function ZP.refreshLayoutButtons() if not ZP.viewButtons then return end local active = activeLayoutName(ZP.mapRatio) for name, button in pairs(ZP.viewButtons) do button:setStyleSheet(name == active and VIEW_BUTTON_ACTIVE_STYLE or VIEW_BUTTON_STYLE) end end function ZP.setMapRatio(ratio, quiet) ratio = tonumber(ratio) or 0.28 ratio = math.max(0.16, math.min(0.50, ratio)) ZP.mapRatio = ratio if ZP.map and ZP.inspector and ZP.layout then ZP.map.v_stretch_factor = ratio * 100 ZP.inspector.v_stretch_factor = (1.0 - ratio) * 100 if type(ZP.layout.organize) == "function" then ZP.layout:organize() end end ZP.refreshLayoutButtons() if not quiet then echo("Layout: map " .. tostring(math.floor(ratio * 100 + 0.5)) .. "% / inspector " .. tostring(math.floor((1.0 - ratio) * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%") end end function ZP.setLayoutPreset(name) name = trim(name):lower() if name == "room" or name == "inspector" then ZP.setMapRatio(0.18); return true end if name == "balanced" or name == "balance" then ZP.setMapRatio(0.27); return true end if name == "map" then ZP.setMapRatio(0.44); return true end local percent = tonumber(name) if percent then if percent > 1 then percent = percent / 100 end ZP.setMapRatio(percent) return true end return false end local function makeViewButton(parent, key, text, preset, tooltip) local button = Geyser.Label:new({ name="ZeroPointView" .. key, h_stretch_factor=1.0 }, parent) button:setStyleSheet(VIEW_BUTTON_STYLE) button:echo("
" .. text .. "
") button:setToolTip(tooltip, 6) button:setClickCallback(function() ZP.setLayoutPreset(preset) end) return button end local function formatRoomDescription(raw) local text = tostring(raw or "") -- ZeroPoint's MSDP text encoder currently escapes CR/LF/TAB before -- publication. Normalise BOTH those literal escape sequences and real -- control characters. Room descriptions are presentation prose here: -- legacy terminal wrapping must not become inspector paragraphs. text = text:gsub("\\r\\n", " ") text = text:gsub("\\n", " ") text = text:gsub("\\r", " ") text = text:gsub("\\t", " ") text = text:gsub("\r\n", " ") text = text:gsub("\r", " ") text = text:gsub("\n", " ") text = text:gsub("\t", " ") -- Remove area-file indentation and all terminal-formatting runs. Mudlet's -- MiniConsole then performs the only wrapping, based on the actual dock width. text = text:gsub("%s+", " ") return trim(text) end local INSPECTOR_FG = {238, 242, 245} local INSPECTOR_BG = {18, 23, 28} local MUD_COLORS = { x={0, 0, 0}, O={128, 128, 0}, c={0, 128, 128}, z={128, 128, 128}, g={0, 128, 0}, G={0, 255, 0}, P={255, 0, 255}, r={128, 0, 0}, b={0, 0, 128}, w={192, 192, 192}, Y={255, 255, 0}, C={0, 255, 255}, p={128, 0, 128}, R={255, 0, 0}, B={0, 0, 255}, W={255, 255, 255} } local MUD_ATTRIBUTES = {i=true, I=true, v=true, V=true, u=true, U=true, s=true, S=true} local function setConsoleFg(console, color) setFgColor(console.name, color[1], color[2], color[3]) end local function setConsoleBg(console, color) setBgColor(console.name, color[1], color[2], color[3]) end local function setInspectorTextColors(console) setConsoleFg(console, INSPECTOR_FG) setConsoleBg(console, INSPECTOR_BG) end local function hexColorAt(text, offset) local value = text:sub(offset, offset + 5) if #value ~= 6 or not value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end return { tonumber(value:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(value:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(value:sub(5, 6), 16) } end local function renderMudText(console, raw) local text = tostring(raw or "") local length = #text local plainStart = 1 local index = 1 local function flushPlain(last) if last >= plainStart then console:echo(text:sub(plainStart, last)) end end setInspectorTextColors(console) while index <= length do local marker = text:sub(index, index) if marker == "&" or marker == "^" or marker == "}" then local code = text:sub(index + 1, index + 1) local consumed = 0 local color if code == marker then flushPlain(index - 1) console:echo(marker) consumed = 2 elseif code == "#" then color = hexColorAt(text, index + 2) if color then flushPlain(index - 1) if marker == "^" then setConsoleBg(console, color) else setConsoleFg(console, color) end consumed = 8 end elseif MUD_COLORS[code] then flushPlain(index - 1) color = MUD_COLORS[code] if marker == "^" then setConsoleBg(console, color) else setConsoleFg(console, color) end consumed = 2 elseif marker == "&" and (code == "d" or code == "D") then flushPlain(index - 1) setInspectorTextColors(console) consumed = 2 elseif marker == "&" and MUD_ATTRIBUTES[code] then -- Attributes have no safe MiniConsole equivalent; consume them as -- formatting rather than leaking their source tokens into room prose. flushPlain(index - 1) consumed = 2 end if consumed > 0 then index = index + consumed plainStart = index else index = index + 1 end else index = index + 1 end end flushPlain(length) setInspectorTextColors(console) end local function countValues(raw) return #orderedValues(raw) end local function sectionHeader(console, title, count) console:cecho("\n" .. title .. "") if count ~= nil then console:cecho(" [" .. tostring(count) .. "]") end -- Use plain output for the divider: is not a valid cecho tag -- on the user's Mudlet build and was being rendered literally. console:echo("\n────────────────────────────\n") end local function renderSimpleValues(console, raw) local values = orderedValues(raw) if #values == 0 then console:cecho("None\n") return end for _, value in ipairs(values) do console:cecho("• ") renderMudText(console, trim(value)) console:echo("\n") end end local function renderExitRows(console, raw) local exits = normaliseExits(raw) local count = 0 if exits then for _, dir in ipairs(STANDARD_DIRS) do if exits[dir] then count = count + 1 end end end sectionHeader(console, "EXITS", count) if count == 0 then console:cecho("None\n") return end for _, dir in ipairs(STANDARD_DIRS) do local dest = exits and tonumber(exits[dir]) if dest then local destination = "#" .. tostring(dest) if roomExists(dest) then local ok, roomName = pcall(getRoomName, dest) if ok and roomName and trim(roomName) ~= "" then destination = trim(roomName) end end local direction = DIRECTION_LABELS[dir] or dir:upper() console:cecho("" .. string.format("%-10s", direction) .. " › " .. destination .. "\n") end end end local function renderContents(console, data) local people = data.PEOPLE or data.people local objects = data.OBJECTS or data.objects local ships = data.SHIPS or data.ships local furniture = data.FURNITURE or data.furniture local pc = countValues(people) local oc = countValues(objects) local sc = countValues(ships) local fc = countValues(furniture) sectionHeader(console, "ROOM CONTENTS") console:cecho("People " .. pc .. " • Objects " .. oc .. " • Ships " .. sc .. " • Furniture " .. fc .. "\n") if pc + oc + sc + fc == 0 then console:cecho("Nothing of note is here.\n") return end if pc > 0 then console:cecho("\nPEOPLE [" .. pc .. "]\n") renderSimpleValues(console, people) end if oc > 0 then console:cecho("\nOBJECTS [" .. oc .. "]\n") renderSimpleValues(console, objects) end if sc > 0 then console:cecho("\nSHIPS [" .. sc .. "]\n") renderSimpleValues(console, ships) end if fc > 0 then console:cecho("\nFURNITURE [" .. fc .. "]\n") renderSimpleValues(console, furniture) end end local function builderButton(parent, name, text, callback, stretch) local button = Geyser.Label:new({ name=name, h_stretch_factor=stretch or 1.0 }, parent) button:setStyleSheet(BUILDER_BUTTON_STYLE) button:echo("
" .. text .. "
") button:setClickCallback(callback) return button end local function builderFieldLabel(parent, name, text) local label = Geyser.Label:new({ name=name, height=18, v_policy=Geyser.Fixed }, parent) label:setStyleSheet(BUILDER_FIELD_STYLE) label:echo(text) return label end local function styleBuilderInput(widget) if widget and type(widget.setStyleSheet) == "function" then widget:setStyleSheet(BUILDER_INPUT_STYLE) end end local function builderText(widget) if not widget or type(widget.getText) ~= "function" then return "" end local ok, value = pcall(function() return widget:getText() end) return ok and trim(value) or "" end local function builderSetText(widget, value) if widget and type(widget.setText) == "function" then pcall(function() widget:setText(tostring(value or "")) end) end end local function requireBuilder() if ZP.isImmortal then return true end echo("Builder controls are only exposed when the server reports IS_IMMORTAL=1.") return false end function ZP.sendBuildCommand(command) if not requireBuilder() then return end command = trim(command) if command ~= "" then send(command) end end function ZP.updateBuilderVisibility() if ZP.isImmortal then ZP.buildBuilderUI() if ZP.builderWindow then if ZP.adminVisible then pcall(function() ZP.builderWindow:show() end) else pcall(function() ZP.builderWindow:hide() end) end end elseif ZP.builderWindow then pcall(function() ZP.builderWindow:hide() end) end end function ZP.populateBuilder(data) if not ZP.isImmortal or type(data) ~= "table" then return end builderSetText(ZP.builderName, baseRoomName(data)) builderSetText(ZP.builderDesc, formatRoomDescription(data.DESCRIPTION or data.description or "")) local coords = serverCoordinates(data) builderSetText(ZP.builderX, coords and coords.x or "") builderSetText(ZP.builderY, coords and coords.y or "") builderSetText(ZP.builderZ, coords and coords.z or "") if ZP.builderMeta then local vnum = tonumber(data.VNUM or data.vnum) or 0 local area = trim(data.AREA or data.area) local xyz = coords and (tostring(coords.x) .. "," .. tostring(coords.y) .. "," .. tostring(coords.z)) or "UNSET" ZP.builderMeta:echo("#" .. tostring(vnum) .. " • L" .. tostring(ZP.buildLevel) .. " • XYZ " .. xyz .. (area ~= "" and (" • " .. area) or "")) end end function ZP.setImmortalState(value) ZP.isImmortal = tonumber(value) == 1 or value == true or tostring(value):lower() == "true" ZP.updateBuilderVisibility() if ZP.isImmortal and msdp and type(msdp.ROOM) == "table" then ZP.populateBuilder(msdp.ROOM) end end function ZP.setBuildLevel(value) ZP.buildLevel = tonumber(value) or 0 ZP.updateBuilderVisibility() if ZP.isImmortal and msdp and type(msdp.ROOM) == "table" then ZP.populateBuilder(msdp.ROOM) end end function ZP.disableMapRoomNames() if type(setMapUserData) == "function" then pcall(setMapUserData, "room.ui_showName", "0") end if type(getRooms) == "function" and type(setRoomUserData) == "function" then local ok, rooms = pcall(getRooms) if ok and type(rooms) == "table" then for roomID, _ in pairs(rooms) do local id = tonumber(roomID) if id then pcall(setRoomUserData, id, "room.ui_showName", "0") end end end end end function ZP.buildBuilderUI() if not ZP.isImmortal then return false end if ZP.builderBuilt and ZP._builderRevision == ZP.uiRevision and ZP.builderWindow then return true end if not Geyser or not Geyser.UserWindow or not Geyser.VBox or not Geyser.HBox or not Geyser.Label or not Geyser.CommandLine then return false end if ZP.builderWindow and type(ZP.builderWindow.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() ZP.builderWindow:delete() end) end
